headRight.text: Designed covers and the reel use one GPU material from Glyphfield, gem smoke, driven by two color uniforms: a dark base and a brand color. Partner covers change only the brand color and the lockup, so the partner color is each page's single accent.

figures.caption: The GT open-source announcement cover sets the brand color to GT blue.
The Fumadocs grantee profile cover sets the brand color to Fumadocs orange.
